run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T16:41:14Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for frontend is explained by the ad service being unavailable. The single ad pod (ad-554b849958-l9ft5, Deployment ad, otel-demo) has been OOMKilled (exit 137) repeatedly: previous instance terminated at 16:42:28Z and current instance at 16:43:30Z, restartCount 4, Ready=False (ContainersNotReady) since 16:43:31Z, with 23 BackOff restarts recorded at 16:48:07Z. Its container memory limit is 450Mi and working set climbed steadily from 331 MB at 16:15:14Z to 372 MB at 16:40:14Z (pod-level max 471.7 MB vs a 471.9 MB limit) before collapsing at restart. The ad Service has no ready address - only notReadyAddresses for that pod. Frontend's error spans begin at 16:41:00Z, exactly when the ad memory/restart cycle started, and are confined to the GetAds path: grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data and GET all show the same 552 error spans in the window, while every other frontend RPC operation shows 0 errors. frontend-proxy also emitted error spans on ingress (569.25) and router frontend egress (553.01). The frontend pod itself is Ready with 0 restarts and no crash. No trace-level error text or gRPC status code is available because Jaeger's newest spans end at 16:31:30Z, and the trace metrics stop around 16:54:14Z, so the state after that is unknown.

claims.text: Frontend error spans in 15:41:14Z-16:58:30Z are confined to the ad call path: span_name grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, GET, GET /api/data and executing api route (pages) /api/data each show about 552 error spans, plus tcp.connect about 19.28; grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations and the cart/checkout route spans all show 0 error spans.

Frontend error spans per 5-minute increase were 0 at every step from 16:20:00Z through 16:40:00Z, then rose from about 36.7 in the window ending 16:41:00Z to 270 in the windows ending 16:48:00Z and 16:49:00Z, and were about 59 in the window ending 16:53:00Z; the last sample returned was 16:54:00Z. The same series shows the error operations as only GET, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect.

Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (container ad) has restartCount 4, started=false, ready=false, and its last termination was reason OOMKilled with exitCode 137 finished at 2026-11-16T16:43:30Z; the instance before it was also OOMKilled with exitCode 137 at 2026-11-16T16:42:28Z. The pod's Ready and ContainersReady conditions are False with reason ContainersNotReady since 2026-11-16T16:43:31Z.

Kubernetes events for ad-554b849958-l9ft5 show a Warning BackOff 'Back-off restarting failed container ad' with count 23 at 2026-11-16T16:48:07Z, plus Normal Created/Started container ad with count 6 at 2026-11-16T16:44:59Z.

Deployment ad in otel-demo runs image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad with container ad resources requests cpu 10m / memory 225Mi and limits cpu 50m / memory 450Mi; its status has no readyReplicas and no availableReplicas at query time, while Deployment frontend reports readyReplicas 1 and availableReplicas 1.
Service ad's Endpoints object contains only notReadyAddresses (pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5, ip 100.96.2.230, port 8080); it has no ready address, so the service has no ready backend.

Container ad's memory working set grew almost monotonically from 331,190,272 bytes at 16:15:14Z to 371,867,648 bytes at 16:40:14Z, then fell to 66,805,760 / 53,465,088 / 34,598,912 / 286,720 bytes over the following minutes and later re-grew from 123,588,608 bytes at 16:47:14Z to 189,202,432 bytes at 16:50:14Z; over the window the pod-level max working set was 471,658,496 bytes and the container-level max was 371,867,648 bytes, against the container memory limit of 450Mi (471,859,200 bytes).

The ad service's own spans show no error status on its server operation: oteldemo.AdService/GetAds is STATUS_CODE_UNSET with about 1348.5 spans in the window (getAdsByCategory 1167.9 and getRandomAds 377.5 likewise UNSET); the only ad error-status spans are flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream with about 2.03 spans.

Error-status span increases over 15:41:14Z-16:58:30Z by service were frontend about 2227.28, frontend-proxy about 1122.26, ad about 2.03, fraud-detection about 3.05 and recommendation about 3.04, while accounting and payment returned series with value 0.
frontend-proxy's own error spans are on span_name ingress (about 569.25) and router frontend egress (about 553.01) in the window.

The frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx is Running and Ready with restartCount 0; its container working set max was 129,400,832 bytes against a 200Mi memory limit, and its CPU CFS throttled periods were 27.17% of periods over the window.

There is no ad-specific rollout: all 21 deployments in otel-demo were created at 2026-11-16T16:02:50Z, all pods at 16:02:50Z-16:04:32Z (ad-554b849958-l9ft5 at 16:02:50Z), Deployment ad is generation 1 with status.observedGeneration 1, and its ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (created 16:02:50Z, owned by Deployment ad) reports 1 replica.

ad container logs contain 2678 lines of ordinary ad request handling ('Targeted ad request received for [...]', 'Non-targeted ad request received...', 'no baggage found in context') read through 2026-11-16T16:39:19Z; the container has no readable previous instance.

Deepest supported cause chain: the ad container's memory working set grew until it hit its 450Mi container limit, the kernel OOMKilled it (exit 137) at about 16:41-16:43Z and again in BackOff retries, leaving the single-replica ad Service with no ready endpoint; frontend's gRPC calls to oteldemo.AdService/GetAds therefore failed starting 16:41:00Z, which raised frontend's request error rate above 0 and fired RequestErrorRate, and frontend-proxy surfaced errors proxying to frontend.

The frontend tcp.connect error spans (about 19.28 over the window, with a burst of about 10-14.4 per 5-minute window at 16:41-16:45Z) are TCP connection attempts from frontend to the ad service that failed while the only ad pod had no ready endpoint. This is a hypothesis because the spans' peer address/parent references were not visible in the returned evidence.

frontend-proxy's ingress and 'router frontend egress' error spans are propagation of frontend returning errors on /api/data to its clients; the proxy's egress error count (about 553.01) is close to frontend's per-operation error count (about 552) and both are in the same window.

The ad process was not returning application errors at the time of the failures: its own oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server spans carry STATUS_CODE_UNSET (about 1348.5 spans) with no error status, and its captured logs up to 16:39:19Z show normal request handling with no error/panic/fatal lines among 2678 lines. This points to the ad pod being unreachable/restarting rather than returning failed responses.

The frontend itself did not crash or saturate memory: frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx is Ready with restartCount 0 and working set about 129 MB against a 200Mi limit, and errors are limited to the GetAds path while its cart, checkout, product-catalog and recommendation RPC operations show 0 error spans.

Rejected: flagd or the flagd event-stream errors caused the frontend error-rate spike. The flagd pod (flagd-67b67fffd9-qz6gw, containers flagd and flagd-ui) is Ready with restartCount 0, and the only error spans on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation are flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream with about 2-3 spans each over 77 minutes, far too small and on a different operation path than the frontend GetAds failures.

Rejected: frontend CPU throttling was the cause of the measured request errors. Frontend CFS throttled periods were 27.17% of periods over the window and could add latency, but the error spans are exclusively on the AdService/GetAds path while other frontend RPC operations had 0 error spans, and the ad pod was concurrently OOMKilled with no ready endpoint.

Investigate and fix the ad service's memory behaviour and its 450Mi container limit: the container working set climbed from about 331 MB to 372 MB in 25 minutes before the OOMKills and began climbing again after restart (about 123 MB to 189 MB between 16:47 and 16:54), while its request is only 225Mi. Raising the limit alone would defer, not remove, the symptom if usage keeps growing.

Remove the single point of failure on ad: run more than one ad replica (Deployment ad currently spec.replicas 1) so one OOMKilled pod does not leave the Service with zero ready endpoints, and alert on ad container working set approaching its limit in addition to the caller-side RequestErrorRate.

gaps: No trace-level detail for the failing period: Jaeger's returned spans end at 2026-11-16T16:31:30Z, and traces_search for frontend in 16:38:00Z-16:46:00Z and 16:30:00Z-16:58:30Z with error=true returned no traces, so error text, gRPC status codes and parent-child links for the failing GetAds/tcp.connect spans are unknown.

The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not retrievable: list_prometheus_rules returned no rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate or type alert (no_data), so the alert's exact expression, ratio window and error denominator are unknown.
rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count returned no series or labels for the window, so frontend-to-ad gRPC status codes and client durations could not be verified.

kube_deployment_status_replicas_available and kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready returned no series for otel-demo/ad and otel-demo/frontend, so the deployment availability timeline could not be charted; only live object status was available.

Frontend and ad crash-time logs are missing: the frontend container log read returned 0 lines, ad's previous container instance is unavailable (HTTP 400 previous terminated container not found) and ad's current-instance log read ends at 16:39:19Z, so no container log covers the 16:41-16:48 OOM cycle.

Trace and container metric series stop around 2026-11-16T16:54:14Z; instant queries at 16:58:30Z returned no data, so whether frontend errors persisted and whether ad kept OOM-looping after 16:54 is unknown.

Error-span series were not returned for product-catalog, cart, checkout, currency, email, shipping, quote, image-provider, kafka or load-generator in this window, so their error status is unknown rather than zero.

The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so whether the ad memory limit, image or workload configuration changed before the incident could not be verified; Deployment ad shows generation 1 / observedGeneration 1, which only argues against a spec change being observed via the current object.
next_steps: Review ad container memory usage and the 450Mi limit (requests 225Mi) on Deployment ad in otel-demo, and determine whether the steady growth is an application leak or undersized memory.
Consider increasing Deployment ad replicas above 1 so a single OOMKilled pod cannot remove the Service's only ready endpoint, and add memory headroom alerting for container ad.
Inspect Alertmanager/Prometheus rule configuration for RequestErrorRate to confirm the metric, ratio window and threshold it evaluates.
Once ad is stable, re-check frontend's error rate and the frontend-proxy ingress 5xx spans to confirm the alert clears.

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.
